PC: Did the student ask our chief complaint? (“What brings you in ?”)
Did the student attend to your comfort and modesty during the physical exam?
Was the progression of the physical exam fluid?
Did the student perform all physical exam procedures on skin?
Did the student elicit that you have a long history of infections?
Did the student ask about infections during your childhood?
Did the student ask if you are short of breath?
Did the student examine your skin?
Did the student examine your nose?
Did the student look in your ears?
Did the student look in your mouth?
Did the student examine your neck for lymph nodes?
Did the student examine your lungs?
Did the student examine your spleen (by palpation or percussion of left upper abdomen or lower ribcage)?
Did the student examine your nails?
MK:
Identification of specific (CVID or IgA deficiency) primary immunodeficiency as a cause of recurrent sinopulmonary infections (2 points) – only 1 point for PIDD without specific type or incorrect type
Historical support (1 point)
PE support (1 point)
Depth of explanation (1 point)
Prioritization (1 point)

Granulomatosis with polyangiitis (2 points) – only 1 point for general vasculitis
Historical support (1 point)
PE support (1 point)
Depth of explanation (1 point)
ICS: Did the student refrain from exhibiting any distracting non-verbal behaviors? (i.e. flat affect, eye contact, posture, playing with hair, pen clicking, space building, swaying on stool, etc.)
Did the student use the skills of empathy in relation to an expressed or potential feeling/emotion (reflection, legitimation, exploration)
Did the student elicit the impact on your life, your concerns or your explanatory model? (“what do you think is going on?” or “Why do you think this happened?”)
Did the student update you as to what to expect during the physical exam?
Is the student proficient in English? (syntax, word choice)
Was the student’s articulation understandable? (fluency, clarity, pronunciation)
Did the student use medical jargon without explain it?
Did the student review and summarize the gathered information from the history of present illness (HPI), at any time during the encounter?
PROF: Did the student sanitize their hands with soap and water or Purell, before an physical contact? (also prior to PE if applicable)
Did the student leave the room when the “end of the encounter” prompt was made?
Did the student avoid verbal or nonverbal judgmental behaviors?
